$comment: Seeded history for the protection-plan scenario (002 quickstart R14): an approved accidental-damage claim (a cracked screen) of BS11-24-0015, finalized more than 90 days ago so it raises no duplicate-claim signal. photoDamageTypes seeds its photo analysis, so claim_history_lookup counts the serial's one included accidental-damage incident as used. The duplicate-window scenario (quickstart S18) runs on Aurora. Dates are signed day offsets from the seeding day (negative = in the past).

claims.problemDescription: The tablet fell off the kitchen counter and the screen glass cracked in one corner.
claims.explanation: Your Borealis Care plan includes one accidental-damage repair in the first 12 months, so your screen will be repaired.
